_what: An opt-in local road for AI programs on this Mac (a coding CLI, a script) to run the tools this Mac host keeps without going through the account (computer/local-socket.mjs). Off until `enabled` is true. The socket sits in a folder only the person can enter (folder_mode 0700, socket_mode 0600), so only programs the person runs reach it. `allowed_tools` is null to allow every tool the host keeps, or a list of tool ids. Every answer is signed with a key kept in `secret_file` (0600), so a caller that holds that file can tell the answer came from this host.

words.bad_request: Send one JSON line: { id, tool_id, input }.
words.not_allowed: {tool} is not one this Mac answers on the local road.
